data.body: OSS comparison checkpoint. Verified current generation practices in CPython, Kubernetes, Go, LLVM, OpenAPI Generator, and Rust through pinned GitHub default-branch commits. The comparison rejects a central record for every output because it would duplicate build graphs, generator-local tables, and declarative job manifests. The revised F05 uses one descriptor per heterogeneous checked-in generator family and one explicit aggregate list that generates the documentation catalog and aggregate checks. Kubernetes supplies the temporary-worktree and stale-output cleanup reference. OpenAPI Generator supplies the per-run output manifest reference. Rust supplies typed owner-local steps and shared output functions. CPython and Go demonstrate the incompleteness risk of aggregate-only or distributed-only ownership. No project file changed.
